paper.title_en: Periodic orbits and gravitational waveforms of spinning particles in nonlocal gravity
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the dynamics and gravitational-wave signatures of periodic orbits of spinning test particles moving in the equatorial plane around static, spherically symmetric black holes within the framework of Deser-Woodard nonlocal gravity. Based on the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations, combined with the Tulczyjew spin supplementary condition, we derive the orbital dynamic equations for spinning particles moving in the equatorial plane and impose a timelike constraint to exclude unphysical superluminal trajectories. By comparing with the classical Schwarzschild black hole, we systematically analyze the effects of the nonlocal gravitational parameters $ζ$ and $b$ on the effective potential governing the radial motion of particles and the innermost stable circular orbit. In addition, gravitational waveforms exhibit significant phase differences: an increase in $ζ$ induces a phase delay, whereas an increase in $b$ results in a phase advance. Using periodic-orbit waveforms extended over a one-year interval with fixed orbital parameters, we obtain an order-of-magnitude estimate of the sensitivity of the waveform mismatch to nonlocal corrections. For the configurations considered, this estimate suggests sensitivity to $ζ$ of order $10^{-6}$ when $b=2$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在Deser-Woodard非局域引力框架下研究自旋测试粒子的周期轨道与引力波波形，属于修改引力家族；结合Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon方程与Tulczyjew自旋补充条件，系统分析非局域参数对有效势、最内稳定圆轨道和波形相位的影响，并给出波形失配对非局域修正灵敏度的量级估计，理论深度与方法细节较充分，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 非局域引力中自旋粒子的周期轨道与引力波波形
decision.abstract_zh: 本文在Deser-Woodard非局域引力框架下，研究了在赤道面内围绕静态球对称黑洞运动的自旋测试粒子的周期轨道的动力学与引力波信号。基于Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon方程，并结合Tulczyjew自旋补充条件，我们导出了在赤道面内运动的自旋粒子的轨道动力学方程，并施加类时约束以排除非物理的超光速轨迹。通过与经典Schwarzschild黑洞比较，我们系统分析了非局域引力参数$\zeta$和$b$对支配粒子径向运动的有效势以及最内稳定圆轨道的影响。此外，引力波波形表现出显著的相位差异：$\zeta$的增大会引起相位延迟，而$b$的增大会导致相位超前。利用在固定轨道参数下延展至一年区间的周期轨道波形，我们获得了波形失配对非局域修正灵敏度的量级估计。对于所考虑的构型，该估计表明当$b=2$时对$\zeta$的灵敏度可达$10^{-6}$量级。
